items.a: Valet trash (also called doorstep trash) is a nightly amenity where residents place tied bags in a container outside their door and we collect them — five nights a week — and transport the waste to your on-site dumpster or compactor. No more dumpster runs for residents; no more overflowing bins for you.
Yes — A&K Premier Property Solutions is fully licensed and insured. We're happy to provide certificates of insurance to any client on request.

items.q: How much does valet trash cost?
items.a: Pricing depends on your door count, community layout, and service frequency. Use our Profit Calculator above to model NOI, or request a free proposal for an exact quote — most quotes are turned around within 48 hours.
We serve apartment communities and HOAs across the DFW metroplex — Dallas, Fort Worth, Arlington, Plano, Frisco, Irving, and surrounding areas. Not sure if we cover yours? Just call (915) 238-0756.
For most properties, service can begin within one week of signing. Emergency and one-time services (bulk pickups, power washing) can often be scheduled within 24–48 hours.
Yes — our office staff and on-site crews communicate comfortably in both English and Spanish.

items.q: What if a resident misses pickup?
items.a: We track pickups nightly. If a bag is missed, tell us within 24 hours and we'll come back and grab it — no charge, no argument.

items.q: Can you handle bulk items too?
items.a: Absolutely. Our Bulk Items service handles furniture, mattresses, and large household items your residents can't take out on trash night. Schedule regularly or on-demand.

story.title: Built for the communities we serve.
story.body:
A&K Premier Property Solutions was born from a simple frustration: too many apartment communities across the DFW metroplex were being underserved by property service companies that treated buildings like accounts and residents like numbers. We knew there was a better way.

Founded and operated locally in DFW, A&K set out with one mission — to deliver the kind of reliable, respectful, and consistent service that property managers and residents actually deserve. We built the company around three simple ideas: show up on time, do the work right, and treat every property like our own.

Today, we serve apartment communities, HOAs, and property managers across the region — from garden-style walk-ups to high-rise towers. Our uniformed crews are trained, background-checked, and fully insured. Our office picks up the phone. And every service we offer — valet trash, recycling, bulk pickup, and power washing — is designed to make your community cleaner, your residents happier, and your job easier.

We're proud to be family-run, bilingual, and rooted right here in Texas. When you partner with A&K, you're not just hiring a service company — you're joining a growing family of communities we're honored to call our own.
